headline: No-Man's-Land Filled; Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle Shift
war_summary: Since the previous issue, the unoccupied Farranac marker has been refilled; the coast now returns one Warden post and ten Colonial posts, with no neutral ground. On the active fronts, Weathered Expanse has moved from five Warden posts against four Colonial to six against three; Crow's Nest and Frostmarch have been the most shaken positions on that front in the past day. Stonecradle has likewise swung one post, three-six becoming four-five, with Buckler Sound the busiest point. Mooring County shows fresh possession changes in the latest two hours, leaving ten Warden posts to two Colonial; The Cut and The Wind Hills have carried the past day's heaviest local traffic. Stlican Shelf remains fixed at five-four under continuing heavy fire. Callahans Passage still records a very large casualty toll without any change of ownership. Earlier flurries at Linn Mercy, Fishermans Row, and Gutter have not reappeared on the possession board, though Linn Mercy's casualty returns are again climbing. War 140 remains undecided.
